description: Incrociato velvet — Colore: Porpoise & silver Collezione: Lucis Codice: 1I04052 Materiale: 9% Cashmere, 91% Cotton Disegno: Modern Scala: Extra Small Altezza: 136 cm Rapporto: 136 cm × 54 cm Toni: Blue-green INCROCIATO takes a singular motif from Fortuny's multi-patterned ASHANTI — the largest design in the collection — and rescales it to highlight its textural character. The hand-drawn quality of the original motif is preserved and amplified in the velvet surface: slightly irregular, gently distressed, with a patina that reads as aged without being worn. The result is a fabric that carries the weight of history without nostalgia, a vintage velvet aesthetic made relevant for refined contemporary interiors. Its medium-scale geometric repeat makes it versatile across upholstery, wall panels, and drapery. Finished with Fortuny's proprietary metallic pigments on a cashmere-cotton ground. Part of the LUCIS Collection .
